end.summary:
Identified litter, plastic, loud noise, feeding animals, touching coral, plucking flowers, and scratching old carvings as harmful.
Explained that coral is fragile and can crack or die when touched or stepped on.
Suggested using dustbins, avoiding loud music, and looking at flowers without picking them.
Responsible-tourism practice: 2 unaided correct responses out of 2.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Tara practised how visitors can harm fragile beaches, coral, plants, animals, and historic carvings, then suggested protective actions such as using dustbins and avoiding loud music. They explained that touching or stepping on coral can make it crack and die. One response suggested giving food to animals; this was not corrected later in the lesson, so please revisit that animals should not be fed by visitors.
